cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with triage group T1 (no bug text was compared). The fixture is a millimetre drawing switched to INSUNITS 6 after CE loaded: a FAIL may be that artefact. A real metre drawing is needed.
cases.expected: With INSUNITS 6, PIT at 150,-80 gives a pit block whose outline is about 1.9 units wide (the 1900 mm outline in metres): the bounding box reads about 149.05,-80.95 to 150.95,-79.05. A pit 1900 units wide would swallow a pipe 20 units long (both ends on the same pit).
cases.why_not_unit: The drawing unit decides how every length is read; only a real drawing shows the placed pit.
